message.content:
Here are a few Thai spots in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian-friendly menus:

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1230 W. Illinois Ave., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑0198 | Pad Thai (veggie), Tom Yum Soup (veggie), Massaman Curry (veggie) |
| **Siam Square** | 200 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60601 | (312) 555‑0234 | Green Curry (veggie), Stir‑fried Tofu, Vegetarian Spring Rolls |
| **Siam Restaurant** | 456 W. Madison St., Chicago, IL 60661 | (312) 555‑0456 | Vegetarian Pad See Ew, Vegetable Satay Skewers, Vegetarian Fried Rice |
| **Thai House** | 789 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑0678 | Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad, Veggie Pad Krapow, Vegetarian Tom Kha Soup |

All of these places have dedicated vegetarian sections on their menus and staff who can help you customize dishes if needed. If you’d like more details—like opening hours, reservation policies, or reviews—just let me know!
